n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

maxn = 510
fact = [0] * maxn
inv_fact = [0] * maxn
invs = [0] * maxn

def precompute():
    fact[0] = fact[1] = invs[1] = inv_fact[0] = inv_fact[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, maxn):
        fact[i] = (fact[i-1] * i) % mod
        invs[i] = mod - ( (mod // i) * invs[mod % i] ) % mod
        inv_fact[i] = (inv_fact[i-1] * invs[i]) % mod

def choose(a, b):
    return (fact[a] * (inv_fact[b] * inv_fact[a - b] % mod)) % mod

def total_sum(x):
    return x * (x + 1) // 2

precompute()

f = [0] * maxn
c = [0] * maxn
dpX = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
dpY = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]

f[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        f[i] = (f[i] + (choose(i - 1, j) * f[j] % mod) * f[i - 1 - j] % mod) % mod
        c[i] = (c[i] + ( (i + 1) * choose(i - 1, j) % mod) * ( (f[j] * c[i - 1 - j] % mod) + (f[i - 1 - j] * c[j] % mod) ) % mod) % mod
        c[i] = (c[i] + (choose(i - 1, j) * (total_sum(j) + total_sum(i - 1 - j)) % mod) * (f[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % mod)) % mod
    f[i] = (f[i] * (i + 1)) % mod

for i in range(maxn):
    for j in range(maxn):
        dpX[i][j] = 0
        dpY[i][j] = 0

dpX[0][0] = 1
for k in range(1, n + 1):
    dpX[k][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, min(m, k) + 1):
        dpX[k][i] = dpX[k - 1][i]
        dpY[k][i] = dpY[k - 1][i]
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            val_x = (f[j] * dpX[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            val_x = (val_x * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dpX[k][i] = (dpX[k][i] + val_x) % mod

            val_y1 = (c[j] * dpX[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            val_y1 = (val_y1 * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dpY[k][i] = (dpY[k][i] + val_y1) % mod

            val_y2 = (f[j] * dpY[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            val_y2 = (val_y2 * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dpY[k][i] = (dpY[k][i] + val_y2) % mod

print(dpY[n][m])
